title: Specify instructions, inputs, constraints, and expected output as a versioned task interface whose quality is measured on representative cases

questions.prompt:
An LLM extracts delivery dates from customer messages. Each message contains at most one explicitly stated delivery date. The receiving program requires a JSON object with exactly one key, `delivery_date`: its value must be the date copied exactly as written, or `null` when no delivery date is stated. No surrounding text is accepted.

Rewrite this draft prompt to specify the required behavior and output contract. Keep `{{message}}` as the input placeholder.

```text
Extract the delivery date from this customer message:
{{message}}
```

rubric.point: Requires copying an explicitly stated delivery date exactly as written and returning null when none is stated, without inferring a date.
Requires only a JSON object containing exactly the delivery_date key, with a string or null value and no surrounding text.
